id.description: The numerical ID of the Project.

description.example: Description of this Project to show on Central.
description.description: The description of the Project, which is rendered as Markdown on Frontend.

keyId.description: If managed encryption is enabled on the project, the numeric ID of the encryption key as tracked by Central is given here.

archived.description: Whether the Project is archived or not. `null` is equivalent to `false`. All this does is sort the Project to the bottom of the list and disable management features in the web management application.
